rows.title: Diesel fuel tax to rise sharply in CT; Experts say costs will hit consumers
rows.standfirst: A big CT tax hike on diesel in July and a new highway truck fee in January could drive up the cost of groceries and other goods.

rows.title: CT state employee retirements top 4,330 since Jan. 1
rows.standfirst: The state has seen nearly double the number of retirements of state workers this year than it faced annually between 2019 and 2021.

rows.title: GOP tries to reignite tax-cutting debate
rows.standfirst: Republican legislative leaders in Connecticut want a special session before July 1 to expand state tax cuts to counter rising inflation.

rows.title: More than 90,000 households sign up for CT child tax rebate in first week
rows.standfirst: Connecticut officials are encouraging residents with children to file for the $250-per-child tax rebate by July 31.

rows.title: With $875M fund for needy towns, Lamont touts ‘step in right direction’
rows.standfirst: The election-year adjustment in how Connecticut funds community projects was sought by a Black and Puerto Rican Caucus frustrated by the governor’s “debt diet.”

rows.title: CT government overtime is on the rise as overall payroll shrinks
rows.standfirst: As the overall size of Connecticut’s government workforce shrinks, overtime was growing by 11% this fiscal year.

rows.title: CT’s diesel tax will jump 9 cents on July 1
rows.standfirst: The nearly 23% increase comes six months before Connecticut is set to implement a new highway use tax on large commercial trucks.

rows.title: Labor advocates say CT too frugal with pandemic pay for private sector
rows.standfirst: Labor advocates fear the state’s pandemic pay program for essential private workers may not have enough funds for all who risked their lives.

rows.title: CT employee retirements top 4,400 as July 1 deadline looms large
rows.standfirst: CT state worker retirements in the first six months of 2022 are double the average of the past three years.

rows.title: Gov. Lamont directs CT agencies to waive credit and debit transaction fees
rows.standfirst: Lamont hailed it as inflation relief, but Republicans called it a token attempt and renewed the GOP’s demand for a state income tax cut.

rows.title: Repealing tax relief in CT: Same as a tax increase, or just bad policy?
rows.standfirst: CT has endured a legacy of promised-then-canceled tax cuts. Republican Bob Stefanowski says it’s the same as tax hikes. Democrats disagree.

rows.title: Lamont says CT state worker retirement ‘tsunami’ was milder than feared
rows.standfirst: Although more than 4,400 state employees will have retired since January, the state has hired more than 6,000 this fiscal year.

rows.title: CT lawmakers want a closer look at inequality, and now the law demands it
rows.standfirst: Whoever wins this fall’s gubernatorial election cannot, by law, propose a new budget without showing how it addresses inequities.
